declarations.state_ownership: Owns the hci schema in its own PostgreSQL 15.8 container hci-postgres, never the shared Supabase (Projects/internal/hci30/app/server.mjs:80-91, ADR-0021 / ADR-0002 as cited there): tenants, cases, persons, subject_records, source snapshots and relationships, decisions, decision_claims, data_encryption_keys and the rest, built by Projects/internal/hci30/database/migrations 0001-0020 (docs/domain/HCI_DOMAIN_ERD.md and HCI_ENTITY_DICTIONARY.md list every table). Raw fetched pages live in its own object storage hci-object-storage (hetzner-phase1-core/docker-compose.yml service hci-object-storage). Today the data is synthetic only: two hardcoded test tenants a and b (server.mjs:42-48; README). next-admin keeps only the knowledge-base link column from migration 0088 (lobster-factory/packages/db/migrations/0088_kb_hci_link.sql); lib/hci holds the import client and this manifest.
declarations.behavior_ownership: Human-centred investigation cases: Projects/internal/hci30/app/server.mjs (cases, persons, subject records, reports, decisions, discovered-source seeds), packages/intelligence/* (trust-domain roll-up, evidence quality, severity floor, rule engine; server.mjs:8-12), public-intelligence/* (discovered-source orchestration, sink and promotion; server.mjs:14-21). Fetching a target is the fetch runner's job only, never the app's (server.mjs:93-101, ADR-0029). In next-admin: lib/hci/client.ts and lib/hci/import-sources.ts send knowledge-base URLs to HCI-30 seeds (frozen since 2026-09-23, lib/research-bridges.ts:1-22).
declarations.public_api_event_contract: HTTP (Express, application/problem+json errors, server.mjs:114, :127): GET /health (:138), GET/POST /api/hci/v1/cases (:147, :168), POST cases/:caseId/reopen, risk-tier, auto-promote-rule-findings, reports, records, decisions (:215-536), GET/POST /api/hci/v1/persons (:294, :305), GET/POST /api/hci/v1/seeds, seeds/:sourceId/reject, content, promote (:570-726). Conventions: Projects/internal/hci30/api/API_CONTRACT_STANDARD.md, api/openapi/hci-v1.yaml, api/asyncapi/hci-events-v1.yaml. Caller from next-admin: POST /api/ops/clients/[slug]/hci-import, which answers 410 while the research bridges are frozen (lib/research-bridges.ts:22).
declarations.invariants: Every tenant-owned table has tenant_id NOT NULL, RLS enabled and forced, policy tenant_id = hci.current_tenant_id() resolved from the acting Postgres role, and tenant_id is immutable (docs/domain/HCI_INVARIANTS.md:11-28); a catalog query test fails any tenant table without RLS (HCI_INVARIANTS.md:213). Append-only and no-delete tables are enforced by grants and by reject_update_delete() triggers (HCI_INVARIANTS.md:30-48). There is no universal human trust score (HCI_INVARIANTS.md:199, ADR-0004). The app never fetches a target itself; only the isolated fetch runner does (server.mjs:93-101). No authentication exists yet: the tenant is an explicit request value mapped to a NOLOGIN role (server.mjs:36-48; docs/HCI_C1_C10_DECISIONS.md).
declarations.dependencies: Its own services only: hci-app, hci-postgres, hci-fetch-runner, hci-object-storage (lobster-factory/infra/hetzner-phase1-core/docker-compose.yml, services hci-postgres, hci-app, hci-fetch-runner, hci-object-storage). No Supabase, no Trigger, no AI provider key (process.env reads in app/server.mjs are only HCI_DB_*, HCI_FETCH_RUNNER_*, HCI_DEV_DB_PASSWORD and PORT, :29, :86-101, :767). products.ts dependsOn is empty. The optional next-admin import bridge needs HCI_API_BASE_URL and HCI_IMPORT_TENANT (lib/hci/client.ts:20-22). Not in the ADR 017 section 5 inventory table.
declarations.failure_isolation_boundary: Its database, object storage and fetch runner are separate containers: hci-postgres is reachable only on hci-net, the fetch runner and object storage only on hci-fetch-runner-net, and hci-app alone also joins lobster-net (hetzner-phase1-core/docker-compose.yml hci-app networks), so an HCI failure does not touch Supabase or next-admin data. Without a fetch runner the seed endpoints return a clear 503 instead of doing nothing (server.mjs:93-99). /health is liveness only, without a database round-trip, so a pool problem does not fail deploy health (server.mjs:133-138). SECURITY DEFINER functions are pinned to fail closed under RLS (HCI_INVARIANTS.md:226).
declarations.data_lifecycle: Bitemporal history keeps every superseded version instead of updating in place (migration 0005, HCI_INVARIANTS.md:74); erasure is crypto-shredding: destroying a subject's data key makes its records unreadable (migration 0007_wave1_crypto_shredding_up.sql:1-6, ADR-0018; the DSR-wired erasure is labelled Wave 4 there). Evidence rows are hash-chained for tamper evidence (0018). Append-only tables cannot be deleted or truncated (HCI_INVARIANTS.md:30-48).
declarations.observability_contract: Evidence hash chain (migration 0018) and an immutable audit trail of the auto-promote switch (0019_wave1_case_auto_promote_audit_up.sql:1-5); errors use registered codes (Projects/internal/hci30/database/ERROR_CODE_REGISTRY.md, HCI_INVARIANTS.md:243); GET /health for liveness (server.mjs:138). A cross-box restore drill passed (security/DR_RESTORE_DRILL_RECORD.md, .github/workflows/hci30-restore-drill.yml per README).
declarations.migration_rollback_contract: Every migration 0001-0020 ships a paired _down.sql (Projects/internal/hci30/database/migrations: 40 files, up and down per number). scripts/mutation-check-wave1.ps1 removes each control in turn and requires the negative tests to go red (README).
declarations.replacement_strategy: HCI-30 is a separate application with its own image (hci-app build context ./apps/hci-app) and database; replacing it means another service answering the same /api/hci/v1 contract (api/openapi/hci-v1.yaml). next-admin talks to it only through lib/hci/client.ts, and that bridge can be switched off without effect on either side (lib/research-bridges.ts:1-22).

configuration.apiKeys: None: HCI-30 reads no customer-owned provider key (app/server.mjs process.env reads :29, :86-101, :767).
configuration.generatedByInstall: HCI_DB_PASSWORD, HCI_FETCH_RUNNER_SHARED_SECRET, HCI_FETCH_RUNNER_MINIO_ROOT_USER, HCI_FETCH_RUNNER_MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD, HCI_FETCH_RUNNER_MINIO_IP (hetzner-phase1-core/docker-compose.yml hci-* services); HCI_API_BASE_URL and HCI_IMPORT_TENANT only for the next-admin import bridge.
configuration.readiness: Synthetic-only skeleton without an authentication layer (Projects/internal/hci30/README.md); not installable for a customer until real login exists (docs/HCI_C6_REAL_LOGIN_PLAN.md).
configuration.installUnit: These four services are the HCI-30 subset of the core compose file; the installer takes them, not the whole file (ADR 017 section 5: buyout takes only what it needs from that file).
